normalization.boundaries: Unicode word-character boundaries; multiword triggers require whitespace
normalization.contractions: No expansion; don't, can't, mustn't and hyphenated do-not do not match their spelled-out alternatives
normalization.empty: Do not manufacture units from empty normalized text
normalization.encoding: Strict UTF-8, optional BOM removed; decoding failures stop for review
normalization.links: Inline Markdown links and reference link suffixes removed; raw HTTP(S) URLs removed
normalization.markdown: Remove opening YAML front matter, HTML comments, fence delimiters, heading/list/blockquote markers, link destinations, images, HTML tags, horizontal rules and Markdown emphasis delimiters; retain visible link labels and inline-code content in baseline
normalization.unicode: NFKC then casefold for matching/dedup; curly quotation marks mapped to ASCII
normalization.whitespace: Collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space and trim

parser.code: Fenced backtick/tilde blocks and lines starting with a tab or at least four spaces; baseline retains content but not fences
parser.examples: Heading whose visible text contains whole word example/examples or sample/samples marks following content through next heading of equal or lower depth
parser.inline_code: Retained for lexical baseline; excluded from prose-word denominator and removed in no_code_examples arms
parser.line: Each nonempty eligible physical line after structural stripping
parser.original_implementation_status: Original trigger lists and estimands reproduced. The private parser's code is not available; this public parser reimplements its token boundaries, normalization and deduplication.
parser.paragraph: Blank-line-delimited homogeneous-kind blocks; list items/headings hard boundaries; each contiguous code block is one paragraph
parser.prose_words: Unicode alphanumeric word runs, allowing internal ASCII apostrophe/hyphen; ordinary prose only, after inline-code removal
parser.sentence: Sentence/list-item approximation: join ordinary prose within blank-line-delimited blocks; list items and headings are hard block boundaries; split at .?! followed by whitespace or end, protect decimal points and e.g., i.e., Mr., Mrs., Dr., vs., etc.; fence/indented-code lines are individual units

triggers.counting_unit: At most one P and at most one O per statement, regardless of repeated trigger occurrences
